svg.title: Vale compares the damaged gate, safe detour and two accountable evidence trails.
svg.desc: The opened gate and flood marks remain visible while Babul-da directs vehicles along the raised route. Ila's reason and the contractor evidence stay side by side as Vale asks for the emergency limits to become binding.
